after: Filter existing tree metadata without building a text index; reuse a valid cached index, invalidate it for a different tree or snapshot, and share the existing sorter.
methodology: Three paired Release rounds for each scenario, alternating before/after ordering, fresh process per invocation. Each synthetic fixture has 1,000 directories and 1,000,000 files. Queries select all files or files with allocated size greater than Int64.max (no matches), sorted by size descending. Each service executes cold metadata, repeated metadata, first text query, warm text query, then metadata after text. Phase result arrays are released between queries. RSS is process resident memory sampled approximately every millisecond, not allocation-event volume. Cold-query memory includes the returned result array. Cancellation uses a separate new service after a yield and a 2 ms delay, without sorting. No overlapping builds or tests. All phase counts and ordered fingerprints match across variants.
environment: Apple M5 MacBook Air; 10 cores; 32 GiB RAM; macOS 26.6.2; Xcode 26.6; local APFS
